page.about: . It is not affiliated with İBB, İETT, İSPARK or Metro İstanbul. Arrival times are
; air quality output is not health advice. Use official İETT and Metro İstanbul sources when planning your trip. To speak to a person, call

privacy.band: Your profile stays on your phone or computer; it is not sent to the server. No voice recording is kept. Without an account, no personal data is stored on the server; requests you pass to an operator and photo reports are kept masked for 30 days. Your question is not logged. Your personal data is not sent to the model abroad; only the question you write is sent. Do not write personal information such as your Turkish ID number, card number or health documents in your question.
Personal data and privacy: full text (in Turkish)
note.answer_lang: Answers come in English when the language model is on. Without it, most answers come in Turkish.
fixed.no_data: No data available for this question.
fixed.out_of_scope: I cannot answer that from the data I have. Ask about parking, buses, metro, traffic, air quality or data freshness. You can call İBB's 153 Solution Centre or go to the relevant official page.
fixed.sensitive_refusal: This question is about rights, fares, fines or health. I do not write answers on these topics: wrong information could cost you money, a right or your health. For correct information, call İBB's 153 Solution Centre or check the official page of the relevant institution. If this is an emergency, call 112.
fixed.emergency: This may be an emergency. Please call directly: 112 (Emergency) or 153 (İBB).
fixed.unknown: I could not find a current İBB source I can verify for this. I do not want to guess. You can call 153 or go to the relevant official page.
fixed.ai_notice: I am the Istanbul city information assistant and I use artificial intelligence. I am not an official who makes decisions.
dyn.no_verified_source: The assistant could not find a verified source; it directed you to 153 and the official page.
dyn.stale: May be out of date, check with 153
page.account_note: Optional, with explicit consent; without an account, use stays on this device

page.follow_hint: Tell the assistant "Follow the M2 line" or "Follow the Etiler lift"; it is added only with your approval. Topics without data (water, natural gas, power cuts) are stated plainly.
page.follow_empty: You are not following any topics yet.
